title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Further Deepening the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases
keywords_en: Ministry on Further Deepening Criminal Case Work
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, and Ministry of Justice

Opinions on Further Deepening the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases

Si Fa Tong [2022] No. 49

The High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, and the Justice Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In October 2017, the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice issued the "Measures on Carrying Out the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases," launching pilot work on full coverage of lawyer defense in the trial stage of criminal cases in eight provinces (municipalities directly under the Central Government) including Beijing. In December 2018, the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice issued a notice expanding the pilot work to the whole country. For cases where the defendant did not retain a defense lawyer at the trial stage, the people's court shall notify the legal aid agency to assign a lawyer to provide defense or have a duty lawyer provide legal assistance, thereby effectively protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the defendant. Since the launch of the pilot work, all localities have strengthened overall planning, streamlined communication and connection mechanisms, and strengthened quality supervision of legal aid, achieving positive results. As of now, a total of 2,594 counties (cities, districts) nationwide have carried out the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases at the trial stage, accounting for over 90% of county-level administrative regions. In 2021, the pilot work resulted in an increase of over 320,000 legal aid cases nationwide, accounting for 63.6% of the total number of criminal legal aid cases at the trial stage, and over 550,000 cases where duty lawyers provided legal assistance due to the pilot work. The rate of lawyer defense in criminal cases has significantly increased, and the judicial protection of the human rights of criminal defendants has been further strengthened. However, various localities have also exposed problems such as uneven distribution of lawyer resources, insufficient funding guarantees, and poor work coordination, which need to be resolved through deepening the pilot work. At the same time, the widespread application of the system of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment has also placed higher demands on lawyer defense and duty lawyer legal assistance during the review and prosecution stage.

From January 1, 2022, the Legal Aid Law officially came into effect, marking a new stage of high-quality development in China's legal aid undertaking. The Legal Aid Law makes clear provisions on expanding the scope of notified defense and giving full play to the role of duty lawyers in providing legal assistance, providing a basis for deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases. In order to implement the Legal Aid Law and further strengthen the judicial protection of the human rights of criminal suspects and defendants, the following opinions are hereby put forward on deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases.

I. Fully Recognize the Great Significance of Deepening the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases

1. Deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases is an inevitable requirement for fully implementing Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and implementing the people-centered development philosophy. The people-centered approach is the fundamental stance of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law. The fundamental purpose of advancing the rule of law is to protect the rights and interests of the people in accordance with the law. In criminal cases, the degree of protection of the rights of criminal suspects and defendants is not only related to their vital interests but also reflects the level of judicial civilization. Deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases, on the basis of full coverage at the trial stage, gradually extends full coverage to the review and prosecution stage, better enabling duty lawyers to play a role in providing legal assistance, and providing criminal suspects and defendants with broader, deeper, and more effective criminal defense or legal assistance, so that every criminal suspect and defendant can feel fairness and justice in criminal proceedings.

2. Deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases is an inherent requirement for implementing the Legal Aid Law and continuously improving and perfecting the legal aid system. In August 2021, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress reviewed and passed the Legal Aid Law, which is a milestone in the legalized and institutionalized development of China's legal aid undertaking. The Legal Aid Law puts forward the guiding ideology and basic principles of legal aid work in the new era, expands the scope of legal aid, clarifies specific measures to improve the quality of legal aid and strengthen legal aid guarantees, and sets new and higher requirements for legal aid work in the new era. Deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases is not only a concrete measure to implement the relevant provisions of the Legal Aid Law but also a practical need to further expand the coverage of criminal legal aid and continuously improve and perfect the legal aid system.

3. Deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases is an important measure to fully implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity and accurately apply the system of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment. Promoting the system of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment is an important measure in the judicial field to promote the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity. It is of great significance in timely and effectively punishing crimes, strengthening judicial protection of human rights, optimizing the allocation of judicial resources, and improving the efficiency of criminal proceedings. Deepening the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases, by increasing the participation rate of defense lawyers in handling cases involving guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment, can fully leverage the role of defense lawyers and duty lawyers in guiding criminal suspects and defendants to understand the legal consequences of guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment, and in providing legal opinions on the determination of charges, sentencing recommendations, and case handling, thereby creating favorable conditions for the accurate application of the system of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment.

II. Consolidate the Results of the Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases at the Trial Stage

4. Strive to achieve full coverage at the county level as soon as possible. Justice departments (bureaus) of provinces (autonomous regions) that have not yet achieved full coverage of lawyer defense at the trial stage must effectively overcome difficulties such as insufficient lawyer resources and funding guarantees, accelerate work progress, achieve full coverage of pilot work in county-level administrative regions as soon as possible, and basically achieve full coverage of lawyer defense at the trial stage by the end of the year.

5. Shift from tangible coverage to effective coverage. All localities should, in accordance with the Legal Aid Law and documents such as the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice on Expanding the Pilot Scope of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense in Criminal Cases," promptly summarize the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense at the trial stage, identify weak links in the work, strengthen statistical analysis of important business data, distill good experiences and practices, fully leverage the functional role of defense lawyers and duty lawyers at the trial stage, and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense at the trial stage.

III. Carry Out Pilot Work of Full Coverage of Lawyer Defense at the Review and Prosecution Stage

6. Determine pilot areas. Based on local work realities, each justice department (bureau) shall, after consultation with the procuratorial organ, determine 2 to 3 prefecture-level cities (districts or counties of municipalities directly under the Central Government) to carry out pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense at the review and prosecution stage by the end of November this year. Areas that have already carried out such pilot work may proceed according to the original work plan.

7. Determine the scope of notified defense. If a criminal suspect has not retained a defense lawyer and falls under any of the following circumstances: (1) the suspect may be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years; (2) the suspect or his co-suspects refuse to admit guilt; (3) the case is of major complexity; (4) the case may have a significant social impact; the people's procuratorate shall notify the legal aid agency to assign a lawyer to provide defense. For areas that have already carried out pilot work, the scope of cases for notified defense may be expanded based on local realities.

8. Determine work procedures. Within three days from the date of receiving the case materials transferred for review and prosecution, the people's procuratorate shall inform the criminal suspect of the right to retain a defense lawyer. If the criminal suspect falls under the circumstances specified in Article 7 of these Opinions, the people's procuratorate shall inform him that if he does not retain a defense lawyer, it will notify the legal aid agency to assign a lawyer to provide defense. If the criminal suspect decides not to retain a defense lawyer himself, the people's procuratorate shall record it in the case file and send a notice of defense to the legal aid agency. The notice of defense shall include the name of the criminal suspect, the alleged crime, the place of detention or residence, the reason for notifying the defense, the name and contact information of the procuratorial personnel, etc. The legal aid agency shall, within three days from the date of receiving the notice of defense, determine the lawyer undertaking the case and inform the people's procuratorate in writing of the defense lawyer's name, affiliated unit, and contact information.

9. Duties of the defense lawyer. Defense lawyers shall perform their defense duties in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law, the Lawyers Law, and other regulations. During the review and prosecution stage, the defense lawyer shall explain to the criminal suspect the legal provisions and legal consequences of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment, and provide legal assistance to the criminal suspect in accordance with the law, such as providing legal advice, making suggestions on procedural options, applying for modification of compulsory measures, and submitting applications for review of the necessity of detention. If the criminal suspect voluntarily admits guilt and accepts punishment, the defense lawyer shall provide opinions on the matters specified in Paragraph 2 of Article 173 of the Criminal Procedure Law. Defense lawyers assigned by the legal aid agency shall, from the date of receiving the assignment notice, promptly review the case files and meet with the criminal suspect. For cases where the suspect admits guilt and accepts punishment and the people's procuratorate intends to recommend application of the expedient procedure, the defense lawyer shall complete the file review and meeting within the time limit for handling the case by the people's procuratorate.

10. Effectively guarantee the right to defense. The people's procuratorate shall, in accordance with the law, guarantee the litigation rights of defense lawyers, such as meeting and reviewing case files, and provide convenience for defense lawyers to perform their duties. When making major procedural decisions such as returning the case for supplementary investigation, extending the time limit for review and prosecution, initiating a public prosecution, or deciding not to prosecute, the people's procuratorate shall promptly inform the defense lawyer in accordance with the law and promptly disclose the case process information to the defense lawyer.

11. Arrange file review promptly. If a defense lawyer requests to review case files, the people's procuratorate shall arrange the review in a timely manner. If it cannot be arranged promptly due to work or other reasons, the procuratorate shall explain the reason to the defense lawyer and arrange the review within three working days from the date of the request, and shall not restrict the reasonable number and duration of file reviews by the defense lawyer. Where conditions permit, a platform for scheduling file reviews may be established, electronic file review may be promoted, and downloading or copying of case materials may be allowed.

12. Ensure coordination of legal assistance. If a criminal suspect has not retained a defense lawyer and does not fall under the circumstances specified in Article 7 of these Opinions for which the legal aid agency assigns a lawyer to provide defense, the people's procuratorate shall promptly notify the legal aid agency to arrange for a duty lawyer to provide legal assistance.

13. Handling of refusal of defense. If a criminal suspect falls under the circumstances specified in Paragraph 1 of Article 25 of the Legal Aid Law or Article 7 of these Opinions for which notification of defense is mandatory, and the criminal suspect refuses the lawyer assigned by the legal aid agency to defend him, the people's procuratorate shall ascertain the reason. If the reason is justified, the refusal shall be permitted, but the criminal suspect must retain another defense lawyer; if the criminal suspect does not retain another defense lawyer, the procuratorate shall notify the legal aid agency in writing to assign another lawyer to provide defense. If the criminal suspect refuses the lawyer assigned by the legal aid agency to defend him and insists on exercising the right to defend himself, and the people's procuratorate permits it, the legal aid agency shall make a decision to terminate the legal aid. If the criminal suspect has a justified reason for requesting a change of lawyer, the legal aid agency shall assign another lawyer to provide defense.

IV. Substantially Play the Role of Duty Lawyers in Providing Legal Assistance

14. Improve the stationing of duty lawyers. People's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs shall provide necessary office space and facilities for legal aid workstations and accelerate the construction of legal aid workstations. Judicial administrative organs and legal aid agencies shall, based on the local lawyer resource situation and the demand for legal assistance, flexibly adopt various forms such as on-site duty, telephone duty, and online duty to ensure full coverage of duty lawyer legal assistance.

15. Implement the notification of rights. People's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs shall, at each stage of investigation, review and prosecution, and trial, respectively inform criminal suspects and defendants who have no defense lawyer of their right to meet with a duty lawyer to obtain legal assistance, and provide convenience for criminal suspects and defendants to meet with a duty lawyer. If a criminal suspect or defendant refuses legal assistance from a duty lawyer in a prior proceeding, the case-handling organ in the subsequent proceeding shall still inform him of the right to obtain legal assistance from a duty lawyer, and the relevant circumstances shall be recorded in the case file.

16. Promptly notify the duty lawyer. If a criminal suspect or defendant has not retained a defense lawyer, and the legal aid agency has not assigned a lawyer to provide defense, and the criminal suspect or defendant applies to meet with a duty lawyer, the people's court, people's procuratorate, or public security organ may directly contact the duty lawyer stationed at the scene or immediately notify the telephone or online duty lawyer. If direct arrangement or immediate notification is not possible, a notice of legal assistance shall be delivered to the legal aid agency within 24 hours. The legal aid agency shall determine the duty lawyer within two working days from the date of receiving the notice of legal assistance, and inform the case-handling organ of the duty lawyer's name, unit, and contact information. Except for circumstances where a duty lawyer is notified to go to a detention facility to provide legal assistance, the people's procuratorate or people's court may, in consultation with the legal aid agency, simplify the notification methods and procedures. The case-handling organ shall provide convenience for meetings between the duty lawyer and the criminal suspect or defendant.

17. Effectively guarantee the rights of duty lawyers. If a criminal suspect or defendant has no defense lawyer, the people's court, people's procuratorate, and public security organ shall listen to the opinions of the duty lawyer at the stages of investigation, review of arrest, review and prosecution, and trial, respectively, and fully leverage the role of the duty lawyer in providing legal assistance at each procedural stage. The people's court, people's procuratorate, and public security organ shall, in accordance with the law, guarantee the litigation rights of duty lawyers, such as the right to meet. For cases involving crimes of endangering national security or terrorist activities, during the investigation period, a criminal suspect's meeting with a duty lawyer shall be subject to permission from the investigative organ; if the investigative organ agrees to the meeting, it shall promptly notify the duty lawyer. When a duty lawyer meets with a criminal suspect or defendant, the meeting shall not be monitored. After the case is transferred for review and prosecution, the duty lawyer may review case materials to understand the facts of the case; the people's procuratorate or people's court shall promptly arrange for this and provide convenience. In places where case files have been digitized, the people's procuratorate or people's court may arrange for online file review. For areas with a limited number of duty lawyers and a large volume of cases, duty lawyers may collectively review case files.

18. Duty lawyers shall perform their duties in accordance with the law. When providing legal assistance, a duty lawyer shall fully understand the facts of the case. For relatively complex cases, the duty lawyer shall provide opinions on the handling of the case after reviewing the case materials and fully explaining the relevant litigation rights and procedural rules to the criminal suspect or defendant. If the criminal suspect or defendant voluntarily admits guilt and accepts punishment, the duty lawyer shall, based on the facts of the case, explain to the criminal suspect or defendant the nature and legal provisions of admitting guilt and accepting punishment, provide opinions on the charges alleged by the people's procuratorate, the sentencing recommendations, the application of procedures, etc., and be present when the criminal suspect signs the statement of plea.

19. Complaints and appeals by duty lawyers. If, during the process of providing legal assistance, a duty lawyer considers that a people's court, people's procuratorate, public security organ, or any of their staff members have clearly violated legal provisions, obstructed the duty lawyer from providing legal assistance in accordance with the law, or infringed upon the lawyer's right to practice, the duty lawyer has the right to file a complaint or appeal with the people's procuratorate at the same level or at the next higher level. The people's procuratorate shall promptly review the complaint or appeal, and if the situation is confirmed, notify the relevant organ to correct it.

V. Improve and Perfect the Coordination and Cooperation Mechanism

20. Improve the coordination and consultation mechanism. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs shall strengthen coordination and cooperation, establish and improve coordination mechanisms such as joint meetings and regular consultation and notification, designate liaison officers for the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases, promptly communicate the progress of the work, and coordinate to solve difficulties and problems in the work.

21. Establish an information sharing mechanism. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs shall promptly share important business data, establish work ledgers, unify statistical calibers, conduct statistical analysis, and strengthen business guidance.

22. Improve coordination efficiency. Strengthen information technology development, promote the electronification of various procedures in the pilot work of full coverage of lawyer defense, such as notifications and assignments, further improve work efficiency, allow sufficient time for lawyers to carry out their work, and create favorable conditions for defense lawyers and duty lawyers to perform their duties.

23. Strengthen the protection of lawyers' rights. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and judicial administrative organs shall effectively guarantee all rights of defense lawyers and duty lawyers, and shall not obstruct or indirectly obstruct defense lawyers and duty lawyers from exercising their litigation rights in accordance with the law.

VI. Strengthen Organizational Leadership

24. Seek support from Party committees and governments. All localities shall actively seek the attention and support of Party committees and governments at all levels, proactively report work to Party committees and governments, and effectively implement the guarantee responsibilities of Party committees and governments.

25. Address the problem of insufficient lawyer resources. Establish and improve mechanisms for the lawful cross-regional flow of legal service resources, encourage and support law firms and lawyers to provide services in areas with severe shortages of lawyer resources. Establish and improve mechanisms for the dynamic allocation of lawyer resources. In places where the imbalance of lawyer resources is prominent, provincial-level judicial administrative organs shall take the lead in overall allocation; in other places, in principle, prefecture-level municipal judicial administrative organs shall take the lead in overall allocation. Adopt methods such as paired assistance to improve the capacity of legal aid services. Guide and regulate the participation in criminal legal aid by staff of legal aid agencies who hold lawyer qualifications or legal professional qualifications, and legal aid volunteers with lawyer practice certificates, deeply tap the potential of criminal legal aid personnel, and further strengthen the team. Strengthen legal aid volunteer service work, deeply carry out legal aid projects such as the "1+1" China Legal Aid Volunteer Action and the "Tibetan Aid Lawyer Service Group," and select legal aid volunteer lawyers to serve in areas with no lawyers or severe shortages of lawyer resources.

26. Address the problem of insufficient funding guarantees. People's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs shall cooperate with judicial administrative organs in strengthening communication and coordination with financial departments, jointly promote the implementation of the relevant provisions of the Legal Aid Law on guaranteeing legal aid business funding, increase the funding for handling legal aid cases, dynamically adjust legal aid subsidy standards, and effectively meet the needs of case handling work. Increase the total amount of special central subsidies for local legal aid case handling, and give full play to the guiding role of central subsidies. Judicial administrative organs shall reasonably determine legal aid subsidy standards based on the difficulty of the case and the degree of participation in the case, implement a differentiated subsidy mechanism linking case handling subsidies to service quality, and improve the efficiency of the use of legal aid funds.

27. Strengthen guidance and supervision. The lawyer work departments of judicial administrative organs at all levels shall take the lead in carrying out the pilot work, coordinate the allocation of lawyer resources, organize and guide lawyers to actively fulfill their legal aid obligations, and strengthen the protection of lawyers' rights and supervision of their practice. The legal aid management departments shall do a good job in relevant guarantee work, coordinate with relevant departments to implement pilot work funding, establish and improve mechanisms for cross-regional collaboration in legal aid work, and strengthen guidance and supervision of legal aid quality. Bar associations shall leverage their own advantages as industry associations, cooperate with legal aid management departments in training lawyers participating in legal aid work, and other tasks. Legal aid agencies shall strictly and lawfully handle the acceptance, review, assignment of lawyers, and other work, comprehensively use measures such as file inspections and soliciting opinions from judicial organs to urge legal aid personnel to improve service quality.

October 12, 2022
